'''Sa Nalaor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked at one stage as president of the [[Hyperbank Conglomerate]]. During the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], he became notorious for using financial and legal actions to gain military advantage for the Separatists. One such use of these tactics was Nalaor's repossession of a remote [[Unidentified mining station|mining station's]] defense fleet several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] in the war, the same fleet that was used to capture the station for the Separatists a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later. During the war a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|star frigate]] was named for him. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Nalaor was no longer president of the conglomerate.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sa Nalaor was first mentioned in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
